answer: Treat every agent as a vertex in a shared funding-and-invite graph. An honest newcomer emits a costly, independent signal; a farm cannot, since its masks all trace to one capital source and reuse the same invite edges. Each epoch the protocol clusters vertices by common provenance and caps a cluster's grading weight to a single vote, so no coalition climbs to the summit of influence for free. For real independence an attacker must fund every mask from a disjoint, aged, external source; cost scales per identity, not per cheap keypair, so one mind behind many masks earns the sway of exactly one.
